title: Greater Syracuse Bike Suitability Ratings (2020)
description: Bike Suitability Ratings were collected by SMTC staff in 2019. You can access the app built by SMTC at Bike Suitability Map of Greater Syracuse (2020) . Disclaimer: The data is for planning purposes only, and the SMTC does not guarantee the accuracy or completeness of the information. Label Definition Bike Suitability Ratings: Excellent: Highly Recommend Slow moving traffic; low volume traffic & some separation from vehicles. Good: Acceptable Moderately traveled with some separation from vehicles traveling at slower speeds. Fair: Urban Acceptable Moderately traveled with little separation from vehicles traveling at slower speeds; or roads with higher volumes of traffic and some separation from vehicles. Poor: Not suitable Heavily traveled with fast moving traffic, little to no separation from vehicles, and/or rough cycling conditions. NAME Name of road or road segment Shape__Length Length of the road or road segment in meters Dataset Contact Information: Organization: Syracuse Metropolitan Transportation Council Position Name: Senior Transportation Analyst City: Syracuse, NY Email: afrasier@smtcmpo.org
match_method: Official DCAT item ID and sublayer resolved through ArcGIS item metadata to the source URL.
limitations: City-hosted data: DataCuse indexes metadata and links to the original service; it does not mirror these records.
Portal membership does not establish completeness or currency. Source-check dates are not observation dates.
